Positions use measured text dimensions, leaving at least 10 columns between bands and five rows between stacked peripherals. Edge lines are 1-based.

Evidence is limited to the point definition and eight source texts in context.json, with seed.json as the starting tree. New details include polling revision guards and intervals (EvalsPage.tsx:70-97), merge ancestry and stage-only hashing (evalPromptService.ts:14, 131-164), checkpoint revision boundaries (compareSessionService.ts:32-42), runtime isolation and cache-key composition (agentContextEvalRuntime.ts:18-35), planned-cell coverage and judgement ownership (experimentService.ts:58-99), and stricter placement-backfill requirements (evalRunService.ts:153-175).

The diagrams therefore say workflow rerun. The seed's blanket late-response guarantee is narrowed to usePolled's closed guard; it suppresses updates without aborting the request. Mixed success becomes partial only after queued/generating cells are gone (evalRun.ts:94-99). Judgement run/cell links are optional when reconciliation cannot resolve ownership (judgementService.ts:31-35). Public API labels use setArchived and deleteRun. Validation retries cover validator failures; runtime exceptions escape that loop (evalRunService.ts:654-668).

Imported implementations outside the supplied texts remain dependency boundaries.
